_readme: Suchnayein / announcements for neerajjain.in. Add objects to items[] and they appear sitewide within a minute - no code change needed. Fields: id (unique), title (required), detail, type (info | deadline | urgent | office), due (YYYY-MM-DD, shows an 'X din baaki' countdown once it is within 14 days), expires (YYYY-MM-DD, the item hides itself after this date), url (a page on this site or a full https link), strip (true = also show as the dismissible bar at the top of every page; keep at most one item with strip true).

_example.title: Office 15 August ko band rahega
_example.detail: Urgent matters ke liye WhatsApp par likh dijiye.
